newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shipping bill vote seen on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shipping bill vote seen on Wednesday.

text.p: A bill regulating inland and coastal shipping in Brazil, which prompted a portworkers strike now in its second day, is due to be voted later Wednesday, a congressional official said.

The bill, which was withdrawn from Tuesday's voting session to allow more time for discussion of its contents, was the first item on the agenda of a voting session of the Chamber of Deputies due to begin at 1600 local/1800 GMT, the official said.
The bill would allow foreign companies to operate shipping lines in Brazil and permit shipping companies to use their employees for tasks currently carried out by port unions.
Operations at several ports in Brazil were being held up by the strike which began on Tuesday and continued Wednesday.
